verses.1: Prayer for the poor, that they may be covered, and before Jehovah, their sin may be forgiven.
verses.2: May the LORD hear my prayers and my pleas. May His mercy be upon me.
verses.3: Do not hide your face from me on the day of my distress. Listen to me on that day when I call out to you.
verses.4: For all my days have passed in vain, and my own actions are like ashes that have been scattered away.
verses.5: Oh, how I’m sad! My heart is filled with sorrow, as if I’ve forgotten to eat bread.
verses.6: From the sound of my sighs, I tried to control my speech.
verses.7: I was like a victim of disaster; I was like a wrecked ship.
verses.8: I have suffered, and now I am like a butterfly, flying away from its cocoon.
verses.9: Today, my enemies and those who harm me have humiliated me. They have brought me disgrace.
verses.10: For I have eaten every last bit of it; my mouth is filled with its flavor.
verses.11: Because of your anger and fury, for you took me and threw me away.
verses.12: My days are like a shadow that shifts constantly; I am like a plant that grows and withers away.
verses.13: And you, LORD, will reign forever. Your memory will be remembered from generation to generation.
verses.14: You shall show compassion to Zion, for it is time for her to be saved. For a savior has come.
verses.15: For they desire to serve your stones and your sand.
verses.16: And nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will be under your authority.
verses.17: For Jehovah has created Zion in His glory.
verses.18: They turned away from the prayer of the harasser, and did not pray along with them.
verses.19: Write this down for future generations. May the people who are born after them praise it.
verses.20: For from His holy voice, Jehovah, He looked down from heaven upon the earth.
verses.21: To hear the cry of the prisoner, so that the children of Tamu’ah may be freed.
verses.22: To record in Zion the name of the LORD, and His songs in Jerusalem.
verses.23: In unity, nations and kings shall serve Jehovah together.
verses.24: I suffered in my limited strength during these short days.
verses.25: He said to me, “Help me during the half month of your days, in those years that you will live.”
verses.26: In the beginning, you created the heavens and the earth. Your hands were the instruments through which you created everything in heaven and on earth.
verses.27: Many will be destroyed, and you will stand alone. They will all be like rags; they will be replaced by something else.
verses.28: And you are that one; and your children will never be destroyed.
verses.29: Your servants will lie down, and their offspring will also lie down before you.
